Nineteen comments

“The Thistle Schottische”

I’ve given this with repeats, AABBCC, on order to show a number of different possibilities with it. What will follow will be a few other transcriptions offering more, from the simplest to a few takes by other musicians, including sans > & (3…

↳ Posted by ceolachan on February 23rd, 2010.
